name: What should homeowners prepare before interior framing begins?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before interior framing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a framing contractor arrives, identify the exact layout boundaries and confirm what amenities will exist in the new room. Determine whether you plan to mount heavy items like TVs, shelving, or handrails so proper solid wood blocking can be nailed between studs before drywall covers the framing. Clear at least three to four feet of clearance on both sides of the target wall line, mark potential floor hazards like embedded radiant heat or concrete plumbing drains, and decide on swing directions for planned interior doors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Determine exact wall placements, identify locations for heavy wall-mounted fixtures to plan wood blocking, and clear furniture to allow safe work access along floor and ceiling joists.
